name: rootpath
description: Turn your coding agent into an on-call engineer: graph-powered incident diagnosis, safe remediation and incident memory on FalkorDB.

args: command -v rootpath >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rootpath "$@" || exec uv run --quiet --directory "$ROOTPATH_PLUGIN_ROOT" rootpath "$@"

falkordb_url.title: FalkorDB URL
falkordb_url.description: Optional override. Leave empty to use the settings from rootpath init. Otherwise: redis://localhost:6380 for local Docker, rediss://<user>:<password>@<host>:<port> for FalkorDB Cloud.

graph.title: Graph name
graph.description: Optional override of the graph that holds your system. Leave empty to use the settings from rootpath init.
